label: être / avoir
note: Être: what someone is. Avoir: what they have.
Il est grand. Il a un chat. Elle a dix ans.

sentences.en: People from Madrid are weird.
I am afraid of dogs.
I am tired of the work.
My room has two windows.
He is a law student.
You are young boys.
We have water enough.
We are against war.

label: aller + infinitive
en: to be going to do something
note: Going to do something soon.
aller (vais, va, allons) + infinitive: Je vais manger.

sentences.en: I am going to be fourteen.
We'll begin shortly.
You're going to love this book.
This house will exist.
I'll call the chef.

sentences.t: Je vais essayer de créer ça.
sentences.en: I'll try to create that.
I'll get it.

label: ne … pas
note: Not: the verb sits between ne and pas.
Je ne sais pas. Il ne vient pas.

sentences.en: I do not feel sad.
I'm not crazy.
I'm not old.
I can't eat.

sentences.t: Je ne veux pas quitter Boston.
sentences.en: I don't want to leave Boston.
You cannot lose.

sentences.t: Je ne connais pas si bien Boston.
sentences.en: I don't know Boston that well.

sentences.t: Il ne fait pas toujours froid à Boston.
sentences.en: It's not always cold in Boston.

label: très / beaucoup
note: très: very, before an adjective. beaucoup: a lot.
très grand. Il mange beaucoup. beaucoup de gens.

sentences.en: I can swim very fast.
This apple is very red.
Shape is very important.
His lectures are very long.
I like music very much.
Thank you very much for your help.

sentences.t: Tom a beaucoup d'amis à Boston.
sentences.en: Tom has a lot of friends in Boston.
Mary likes milk very much.

label: pouvoir + infinitive
note: Can, be able to: the form follows the subject.
je peux, il peut, nous pouvons + infinitive

sentences.en: I can read without glasses.
He is able to speak five languages.
You can choose one of them.
We can meet.
Nobody can beat me.
Shut the door, will you?
Can you do as much?
I can do it.

label: vouloir + infinitive
note: Want to: the form follows the subject.
je veux, il veut, nous voulons + infinitive

sentences.en: I want to see the movie.
I want my life back.
Tom wants to move to Boston.
We want further information.
We want to know the facts.
Do you want to be my wife?
Eat as much as you like.
I want to eat some cheese.

label: devoir + infinitive
note: Must, have to: the form follows the subject.
je dois, il doit, nous devons + infinitive

sentences.en: I have to go to bed.
We must think about friends.
We must keep calm.
You have to go.
You have to stay fit.
I must beg your pardon.
Must I open the window?
We must protect the children.

label: venir de + infinitive
note: Just did something.
venir (viens, vient) de + infinitive: Je viens de manger.

sentences.en: Just finished it.
I just got that.
I just found out about it.

sentences.t: Tom vient de rentrer à Boston aujourd'hui.
sentences.en: Tom just got back to Boston today.

sentences.t: Tom vient de revenir de Boston.
sentences.en: Tom just returned from Boston.

label: ce / cet / cette / ces
note: This, that, these: it agrees with the noun.
ce livre, cet homme, cette fille, ces gens

sentences.en: I am familiar with this subject.
Tell me about this guy.
Have you read this article?
I live in this hotel.
I believe that story.
This shoe fits me well.
Learn these names by heart.
Who are those guys?

label: mon / ma / mes
note: My: it agrees with the noun.
mon père, ma mère, mes amis

sentences.en: My brother lives in Tokyo.
Here's my account number.
My father is fifty years old.
My mother likes tea very much.
I sleep in my room.
That's my favorite chair.
I have sore feet.

sentences.t: Un de mes amis te connaît.
sentences.en: One of my friends knows you.

label: quel / quelle
note: Which, what: it agrees with the noun.
quel âge, quelle heure, quel genre

sentences.en: Where do you come from?
What is your favorite band?
What's the side effect?
What are you saving up for?
Which team will win the game?
Which way should I go?
What a beautiful sunset!

sentences.t: Pour quelle raison voulez-vous vous rendre à Boston ?
sentences.en: Why do you want to go to Boston?

label: tout / tous / toutes
note: All, every: it agrees with the noun.
tout le monde, tous les bus, toutes les chaises

sentences.en: Anybody knows it.
What goes around, comes around.
My whole body is sore.
Every bus is full.
All the members were present.
Every seat was full.
Stir once every fifteen minutes.
They all speak French.

label: depuis / pendant
note: depuis: since, still going on. pendant: during, for.
Je vis ici depuis mai. Il dort pendant une heure.

sentences.en: Have you known him for a long time?

sentences.t: Mère est malade depuis jeudi dernier.
sentences.en: Mother has been sick since last Thursday.
I've been here since Saturday.
I have lived in Boston since 1995.
We've been living here since January.
Please wait for five minutes.

sentences.t: Tom a vécu à Boston pendant longtemps.
sentences.en: Tom lived in Boston for a long time.

sentences.t: Tom sera à Boston pendant une semaine.
sentences.en: Tom will be in Boston for a week.

label: il y a
note: There is, there are.
Il y a un chat. Il y a trois chats.

sentences.t: Il y a quatre saisons au Japon.
sentences.en: We have four seasons in Japan.

sentences.t: Il y a une base militaire à proximité.
sentences.en: There is a military base near here.

sentences.t: Il y a un cheveu dans ma soupe.
sentences.en: There's a hair in my soup.

sentences.t: Il y a pourtant une solution.
sentences.en: There is a solution though.

sentences.t: Il y a beaucoup de parcs à Boston.
sentences.en: There are many parks in Boston.

label: par / pour
note: par: by, on, through. pour: for, in order to.
fait par Tom (by); fait pour Tom (for)

sentences.t: J'ai été trompé par son apparence.
sentences.en: I was deceived by her appearance.

sentences.t: Nous avons été attaqués par des pirates !
sentences.en: We were attacked by pirates!

sentences.t: Je suis intéressé par l'Histoire japonaise.
sentences.en: I am interested in Japanese history.

sentences.t: Il m'a dépassé par la droite.
sentences.en: He passed me on the right.

sentences.t: Susan a fait une robe pour Jill.
sentences.en: Susan made a dress for Jill.

sentences.t: Il travaille dur pour atteindre son but.
sentences.en: He works hard to achieve his goal.

sentences.t: Le sport est bon pour votre santé.
sentences.en: Sport is good for your health.

sentences.t: Je vais à Boston pour les vacances.
sentences.en: I'm going to Boston for the holidays.

label: de / que
en: de after a quantity, que after a comparison
note: de after a quantity or a negative; que after a comparison.
beaucoup de temps; plus grand que moi

sentences.t: Mes activités officielles me prennent beaucoup de temps.
sentences.en: My public duties take a lot of time.

sentences.t: Les garçons, ne faites pas de bruit.
sentences.en: Boys, don't make any noise.

sentences.t: Je ne prends pas de risques inutiles.
sentences.en: I don't take needless risks.

sentences.t: Ajoutons-nous un peu plus de sel ?
sentences.en: Shall we add a bit more salt?

sentences.t: Peux-tu nager aussi rapidement que lui ?
sentences.en: Can you swim as fast as he?

sentences.t: Jon est beaucoup plus attirant que Tom.
sentences.en: Jon is far more attractive than Tom.

sentences.t: Mon frère court aussi vite que moi.
sentences.en: My brother can run as fast as I.

sentences.t: Tu as plus d'énergie que moi.
sentences.en: You have more energy than I.

label: il faut
note: It is necessary to; you must.
Il faut + infinitive. Il me faut du temps.

sentences.t: Il nous faut nous dégager d'ici.
sentences.en: We need to get out of here.

sentences.t: Il vous faut choisir votre propre voie.
sentences.en: You have to choose your own path.
I must run.
It is necessary to protect the national unity.

sentences.t: Il faut toujours viser la première place.
sentences.en: One should always aim for first place.

label: passé composé: avoir / être
en: past tense with avoir or être
note: Past tense: avoir for most verbs, être for come, go, stay.
J'ai mangé. Il est allé. Elle est venue. Ils ont fini.

sentences.t: Il est arrivé premier de la course.
sentences.en: He took the first place in the race.

sentences.t: Elle est arrivée avec une solution potentielle.
sentences.en: She came up with a possible solution.

sentences.t: Il est resté fidèle à ses principes.
sentences.en: He remained steadfast to his principles.

sentences.t: Ils sont allés à la piscine publique.
sentences.en: They went to the public swimming pool.

sentences.t: Il a pris part à la course.
sentences.en: He took part in the race.

sentences.t: Il a perdu cet oiseau de vue.
sentences.en: He lost sight of the bird.

sentences.t: Ils ont refusé de publier mon livre.
sentences.en: They refused to publish my book.

sentences.t: Elles ont accordé une interview au journaliste.
sentences.en: They granted the journalist an interview.

label: devrait (should)
note: Should, ought to: the form follows the subject.
je devrais, il devrait, nous devrions + infinitive

sentences.t: On devrait apprendre aux enfants à partager.
sentences.en: Children should be taught to share.

sentences.t: Les enfants devraient jouer à l'extérieur.
sentences.en: Children should play outside.

sentences.t: Tu devrais libérer les animaux de leur cage.
sentences.en: You should free those animals from the cage.

sentences.t: Nous devrions respecter les règles de circulation.
sentences.en: We should obey the traffic rules.

sentences.t: Votre famille devrait passer avant votre carrière.
sentences.en: Your family should come before your career.

sentences.t: Les ceintures de sécurité devraient être interdites.
sentences.en: Seat belts should be banned.

sentences.t: Tu devrais le jurer sur la Bible.
sentences.en: You should swear on the Bible.

sentences.t: Je pense que nous devrions engager Tom.
sentences.en: I think we should hire Tom.

label: ne … jamais
note: Never: the verb sits between ne and jamais.
Je ne mens jamais. Il n'est jamais là.

sentences.t: Je ne suis jamais libre le dimanche.
sentences.en: I am never free on Sundays.

sentences.t: Non, elle n'est jamais tombée amoureuse.
sentences.en: No, she has never fallen in love.

sentences.t: Personne n'a jamais vu chose pareille.
sentences.en: No one ever saw such a thing.

sentences.t: Je n'ai jamais entendu sa chanson.
sentences.en: I have never heard her song.

sentences.t: Il n'a jamais été amoureux auparavant.
sentences.en: He's never been in love before.

sentences.t: Vous ne cessez jamais de me surprendre.
sentences.en: You never cease to surprise me.

label: qui / que
note: qui: who, which as the doer. que: which as the object.
L'homme qui parle. Le livre que je lis.

sentences.t: J'ai un oncle qui vit à Boston.
sentences.en: I have an uncle who lives in Boston.

sentences.t: Ceux qui savent lire ont un net avantage.
sentences.en: Those who can read have a clear advantage.

sentences.t: Celui qui commet l'erreur subit les conséquences.
sentences.en: He who makes the mistake bears the consequences.

sentences.t: Ceux qui violent les lois seront punis.
sentences.en: Those who violate the rules will be punished.

sentences.t: Identifie les mots que tu ne comprends pas.
sentences.en: Mark the words that you cannot understand.

sentences.t: C'est la structure la plus massive que j'ai jamais vue.
sentences.en: This is the most massive structure I have ever seen.

sentences.t: Faites-vous ce que vous estimez être juste ?
sentences.en: Are you doing what you think is right?

sentences.t: Tout ce que vous dites est parfaitement correct.
sentences.en: All that you say is perfectly correct.

label: que + subjunctive
note: que links a wish, aim or time to a subjunctive verb.
Je veux que tu viennes. Avant que ce soit tard.

sentences.t: Je veux que tu ranges la pièce rapidement.
sentences.en: I want you to put the room in order quickly.

sentences.t: Il fait trop sombre pour que je lise.
sentences.en: It is too dark for me to read.

sentences.t: Il est possible que Tom soit un génie.
sentences.en: It's possible that Tom is a genius.

sentences.t: Je suggère que nous prenions une nouvelle approche.
sentences.en: I suggest that we take a new approach.

sentences.t: On devrait l'enfermer avant que ce soit trop tard.
sentences.en: We should lock him up before it's too late.

label: le / lui
en: him, it / to him, to her
note: le: him or it. lui: to him or to her.
Je le vois. Je lui parle. Je lui donne un livre.

sentences.t: Chaque fois que je le vois, il sourit.
sentences.en: Every time I see him, he is smiling.

sentences.t: J'ai tout essayé pour le maintenir en vie.
sentences.en: I tried everything to keep him alive.

sentences.t: Les anciens décidèrent de le chasser du village.
sentences.en: The elders decided to expel him from the village.

sentences.t: Vous pouvez lui confier n'importe quel travail.
sentences.en: You can trust him with any job.

sentences.t: Il lui a donné une feuille de papier.
sentences.en: He gave her a piece of paper.

sentences.t: Il me demanda de lui renvoyer la balle.
sentences.en: He asked me to throw the ball back.

sentences.t: Quelques camarades me virent lui donner du chocolat.
sentences.en: Some classmates saw me give him chocolate.

sentences.t: Une idée brillante lui vint à l'esprit.
sentences.en: He hit on a splendid idea.

label: si / quand
note: si: if, sets a condition. quand: when, gives a time.
Si tu veux, viens. Il part quand il veut.

sentences.t: Que ferais-tu si tu voyais un fantôme ?
sentences.en: What would you do if you saw a ghost?

sentences.t: Si c'était à refaire, je le referais !
sentences.en: If I had to do it again, I would!

sentences.t: Si tu veux être mince, suis ce régime.
sentences.en: If you want to be slim, follow this diet.

sentences.t: J'allais sortir quand le téléphone a sonné.
sentences.en: I was about to go out when the phone rang.

sentences.t: Il leva son chapeau quand il me vit.
sentences.en: He raised his hat when he saw me.

sentences.t: Quand avez-vous eu votre dernier rapport sexuel ?
sentences.en: When did you last have sexual intercourse?

sentences.t: Faites-moi savoir quand vous recevrez le paquet.
sentences.en: Let me know when you get the package.
